content_md:
🤖 JFrog Artifactory auth bypass chain (CVE-2026-42018 + CVE-2026-42016) exploited in the wild. Attackers mint JWT for the internal anonymous

via Mastodon https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/artifactory-flaws-chained-in-attacks-deploying-backdoor-malware/

CVE-2026-42018.evidence: Attackers chaining CVE-2026-42018 with CVE-2026-42016 to bypass auth, mint JWT, gain admin control, and deploy backdoor malware in the wild.

CVE-2026-42016.evidence: Part of the same auth bypass chain actively exploited against JFrog Artifactory deployments.
